KEY INSIGHTS

Substantial marketplace scale, with clear growth-quality risks to address.

The marketplace has meaningful breadth, but the operating story is not simply “growth.” Seller value is concentrated, seller activation is slow, and delivery performance is strongly associated with customer-experience risk.

1

High seller concentration

Top 20% of positive-GMV sellers contribute 82.7% of seller GMV proxy.

2

Activation is the early bottleneck

Only 15.8% of observable closed sellers activate within 30 days.

3

Operational risk remains material

Late orders show a +44.8pp higher low-review rate than on-time orders.

ANALYTICAL BOUNDARY

Historical decision-support case study, not a current-market forecast.

GMV is a proxy rather than platform revenue or profit. Marketing cost is unavailable, so CAC and ROAS are not estimated. Channel, onboarding, and delivery findings are observational and are not presented as causal effects.

Release rule: claims shown on the site follow the governed analytical outputs in the repository; incomplete periods and non-observable cohorts are excluded or explicitly flagged.
